application.name: YOLO26 Detection
application.description: Detects objects with holoscan-yolo26's Yolo26DetectionOp in synthetic frames, JPEG and PPM files or a live V4L2 webcam; checks, prints and times the detections, and can draw them over the frames in a HoloViz window.

changelog.1.0.0: Initial release: the holoscan-yolo26 demo, with synthetic, JPEG/PPM and V4L2 webcam image sources; a HoloViz display with boxes and labels; a report with ground truth, expected detections, latency and annotated PPM output; the module's stub model for model-free runs.

hardware.name: NVIDIA GPU
hardware.description: A CUDA-capable GPU supported by the Holoscan SDK.

hardware.name: Webcam
hardware.description: A V4L2 camera offering YUYV, for the camera mode, which also needs a display.

data.name: YOLO26n (Ultralytics, AGPL-3.0)
data.description: Not part of this repository. The module's tools/prepare_model.py downloads the pinned weights and exports them to ONNX with the separately installed Ultralytics tool. Needed by the demo, files and camera modes only.

data.name: COCO val2017 image 000000039769
data.description: A sample image that prepare_model.py downloads for the demo and the real-model tests.

demo.description: Detect objects in the prepared sample image with YOLO26n, 300 times, printing its detections once and the latency per frame.

files.description: Detect objects in each JPEG and PPM image in the data directory once with YOLO26n, printing the detections and writing each image with its boxes drawn to the build directory.

camera.description: Live webcam with detections drawn over it; needs /dev/video0, a display, and the prepared model.

ci.description: Finite headless check without downloads: 30 synthetic BGR8 frames through TensorRT with the module's stub model, which stands in for YOLO26, every detection checked against the frame's known ones.
